# NoorPath
> A premium Islamic prayer companion iOS app for Muslims who want to build a consistent prayer habit — calmly, privately, and on their own terms.

## Pages
- Homepage: https://noorpath.app
- Privacy Policy: https://noorpath.app/legal/privacy
- Terms of Service: https://noorpath.app/legal/terms

## About
NoorPath helps Muslims track their 5 daily prayers, build streaks, explore Quran Journeys, and grow their spiritual practice. Available on iOS.
